name: Gravitational Synergy (Item Mastery)
body:
Your magic items cause you to be less affected by gravity.

Prerequisite(s): Magic item skill class feature, Acrobatics 3 ranks, Fly 3 ranks.

Benefit(s): When you wear magic items that take up both the feet and shoulder slots, you are under a constant feather fall effect. In addition, once per day you can re-roll a failed Acrobatics or Fly check.
